mapper.insert: insert into tb_repair( rep_item, description, rep_date, stu_id, building_id, room_id, rep_status, rep_man, urgency, repairer_id, images, repair_record, rating, feedback, assigned_time, accepted_time, completed_time )values( #{repItem}, #{description}, #{repDate}, #{stuId}, #{buildingId}, #{roomId}, #{repStatus}, #{repMan}, #{urgency}, #{repairerId}, #{images}, #{repairRecord}, #{rating}, #{feedback}, #{assignedTime}, #{acceptedTime}, #{completedTime} )
mapper.select:
select r.*, b.building_name as b_building_name, ro.brand as r_brand, ro.floor as r_floor, ro.room_capacity as r_room_capacity from tb_repair r left join tb_building b on r.building_id = b.id left join tb_room ro on r.room_id = ro.id
order by
r.urgency desc, field(r.urgency, 2, 1, 0),
r.rep_date desc

select r.*, b.building_name as b_building_name, ro.brand as r_brand, ro.floor as r_floor, ro.room_capacity as r_room_capacity from tb_repair r left join tb_building b on r.building_id = b.id left join tb_room ro on r.room_id = ro.id where r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update tb_repair set rep_item=#{repItem}, description=#{description}, rep_date=#{repDate}, stu_id=#{stuId}, building_id=#{buildingId}, room_id=#{roomId}, rep_status=#{repStatus}, rep_man=#{repMan}, urgency=#{urgency}, repairer_id=#{repairerId}, images=#{images}, repair_record=#{repairRecord}, rating=#{rating}, feedback=#{feedback}, assigned_time=#{assignedTime}, accepted_time=#{acceptedTime}, completed_time=#{completedTime} where id = #{id}

where.if: and (r.rep_item like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: select count(1) from tb_repair where rep_status = #{repStatus}
select count(1) from tb_repair where urgency = #{urgency}
select count(1) from tb_repair where repairer_id = #{repairerId}
select COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) from tb_repair where rating is not null
select count(1) from tb_repair where rating = #{rating}
select date(rep_date) as stat_date, count(1) as cnt from tb_repair where rep_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date(rep_date)
select date(completed_time) as stat_date, count(1) as cnt from tb_repair where completed_time is not null and completed_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date(completed_time)
